rebuiltNote: 重建版：原文件随 E: 盘清空丢失；本文件按 2026-10-05 审计后的 v1.3.0 结构与内容重建，字段结构与规则语义一致，个别英文描述文字为重新撰写。

forbidden: Windows reserved names (CON PRN AUX NUL COM1-9 LPT1-9)
naming.note: user-provided files inside reference_file are exempt from the ASCII rule (CJK allowed)

categories.purpose: final artifacts handed to the user
command output, run logs, session metadata

sharedFolders.purpose: this standard: documents, machine-readable config, deploy staging
workspace-level tooling of the standard itself (not conversation scoped)

referenceFolder.purpose: user-provided reference material: datasheets, papers, images, samples
rules: the agent must never delete, move, rename or overwrite anything inside this folder
user-provided files are exempt from the ASCII naming rule (CJK names allowed)
files the agent creates here must still follow the naming rule
subfolders are allowed; reads are recursive
cleanup or archiving happens only on an explicit user request

conversationFolder.tokenSource: first 8 lowercase hex chars of $env:DSH_SESSION_ID UUID; fallback local time HHmmss
conversationFolder.note: one conversation uses the SAME folder name under every category; reuse if already registered

runtimeEnvironment.categoryRule: one top-level folder per language/tool family, lowercase English, no spaces; never mix two environments in one folder
runtimeEnvironment.verification: verify the vendor SHA-256 and the Authenticode signature (must be Valid) before installing

aiRoot.layout: runtime\<family>\<version>, tools\<name>\<version>, envs\<purpose>, models, datasets, outputs, logs, workspace, mcp (MCP servers), _downloads, _caches
aiRoot.rule: AI runtimes, models, datasets and venvs never go into program_runtime_environment

outputRules: no output files in the workspace root; the root only holds AGENTS.md, README.md, policy, tools, the reference_file drop folder and the category folders
logs longer than about 50 lines go to logs\<conv-id>\; the chat shows only the path and a summary
when a deliverable is superseded, move the old version into archive\<conv-id>\ instead of overwriting it
shared tooling belongs in tools\, not in scripts\

environmentConstraints.impact: the DSH write/edit file tools fail with EISDIR on this volume; create and update files through PowerShell instead
environmentConstraints.encoding: write UTF-8 without BOM via [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText with UTF8Encoding($false); read with explicit UTF-8
environmentConstraints.tls: Invoke-WebRequest and curl.exe fail inside the sandbox; download with node instead
environmentConstraints.temp: point $env:TEMP/$env:TMP at a folder inside the workspace before running pip/venv
environmentConstraints.elevation: writes outside the workspace need the danger-full-access escalation

ruleBackup.separation: must live outside the workspace volume (E: is a removable disk - a same-disk copy dies with it)
ruleBackup.trigger: immediately after any change to policy\ or tools\; pure conversation output changes do not need a backup
ruleBackup.verify: per-file SHA-256 comparison between backup and source; any [FAIL] must be resolved before finishing
ruleBackup.requires: non-read-only mode: writing to %USERPROFILE% needs wider permissions, and read-only also puts PowerShell in ConstrainedLanguage
ruleBackup.background: E: was wiped in 2026-10; policy + tools are the sole carrier of every rule, and rebuilding them was expensive

rootAllowListNotes.eim_config.toml: ESP-IDF installer (EIM) configuration; the installer expects it in the project root, so the root allow list admits it (added 2026-10-14 by user decision)
